1921 is not a leap year (divisible by 4 but not by 100 unless divisible by 400).  
210 days before 1921-12-01:  
October has 31 days, November 30 days.  
From Dec 1 back 1 day → Nov 30.  
Back 30 more days → Nov 1.  
That’s 31 days total back to Nov 1.  
Remaining: 210 − 31 = 179 days earlier.  

From Nov 1 back through October (31 days) → Oct 1 (31 days back).  
Remaining: 179 − 31 = 148 days earlier.  

From Oct 1 back through September (30) → Sep 1 (30 days). Remaining: 118.  
August (31) → Aug 1 (31). Remaining: 87.  
July (31) → Jul 1 (31). Remaining: 56.  
June (30) → Jun 1 (30). Remaining: 26.  
May (31): from Jun 1 back 26 days → May 6 (since May has 31 days, May 6 is 26 days before Jun 1).  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1921-05-06
